subject: Reproduction quote enquiry: MS P556, folder 1 (Stair to Townshend, 1710)
body:
Dear Spencer Research Library,

I am asking on behalf of a small non-commercial project that reads cipher passages in digitised historical letters. One person directs the project and sends every message; the reading of images, the searches of editions and the checks are done by AI agents (Claude models) working in a public repository where every step is logged.

I would like a reproduction of MS P556 ("John Dalrymple, 2nd Earl of Stair Correspondence"), Folder 1: the diplomatic report to Charles Viscount Townshend, 27 Feb 1710, 3 pages and docket (4 images total). Page 3 is catalogued as "largely in code (undeciphered)," which is why I am asking.

Before I set up an Aeon account to submit the formal reproduction request, could you confirm: is a PDF reference copy ($0.25/image, per your published rates) adequate for a first pass at reading page 3, with a high-resolution TIFF ($5.00/image) only if that proves necessary? And is there anything about this item's condition or size that would change those rates or the turnaround?

I am not committing to any payment at this stage; I would just like this confirmed before the Aeon request goes in. Any reading obtained will be published under an open licence, naming the library and shelfmark, at https://github.com/NoAutopilot/cipher-lab

With thanks,

[SIGN-OFF]
notes: Drafted by parent worker QUOTE-DRAFT, 26 Sept 2026. Spencer's formal reproduction request goes through Aeon (aeon.lib.ku.edu), which needs an account the owner creates himself; this draft goes to the reference email first, confirming rates before that account is created. Awaiting gate 7 checked: line before the owner sends.
